user.roleSourceOidcDesc: Calculated from the OIDC groups on every OIDC login
user.roleSourceManualDesc: Set manually, not changed by OIDC groups

me.enable2faDesc: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app or enter the key manually.
me.2faCodeDesc: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
me.disable2faDesc: Enter your password to disable Two Factor Authentication.
me.linkOauth: Link your account with an external provider
me.providerDisabled: Your currently linked provider is not enabled

setup.welcome: Welcome to your first setup of wg-easy
setup.welcomeDesc: You have found the easiest way to install and manage WireGuard on any Linux host
setup.existingSetup: Do you have an existing setup?
setup.createAdminDesc: Please first enter an admin username and a strong secure password. This information will be used to log in to your administration panel.
setup.setupConfigDesc: Please enter the host and port information. This will be used for the client configuration when setting up WireGuard on their devices.
setup.setupMigrationDesc: Please provide the backup file if you want to migrate your data from your previous wg-easy version to your new setup.
setup.hostDesc: Public hostname clients will connect to
setup.portDesc: Public UDP port clients will connect to and WireGuard will listen on

login.rememberMeDesc: Stay logged after closing the browser
login.insecure: You can't log in with an insecure connection. Use HTTPS.

client.name: Name
client.expireDateDesc: Date the client will be disabled. Blank for permanent
client.deleteDialog: Are you sure you want to delete {name}? This action cannot be undone.
client.liveWireGuardDevice: Provisioned via LiveWireGuard (key pair lives on the device)
client.noPrivKey: This client has no known private key. Cannot create Configuration.
client.allowedIpsDesc: Which IPs will be routed through the VPN (overrides global config)
client.serverAllowedIpsDesc: Which IPs the server will route to the client
client.mtuDesc: Sets the maximum transmission unit (packet size) for the VPN tunnel
client.persistentKeepaliveDesc: Sets the interval (in seconds) for keep-alive packets. 0 disables it
client.hooksLeaveEmpty: Only for wg-quick. Otherwise, leave it empty
client.dnsDesc: DNS server clients will use (overrides global config)
client.endpointDesc: IP of the client from which the WireGuard connection is established
client.firewallIpsDesc: Destination IPs/CIDRs this client can access (server-side enforcement). Leave empty to use Allowed IPs. Supports optional port and protocol filtering. See docs for syntax.
client.readOnlyAdvanced: Addresses, allowed IPs, firewall, DNS, MTU, AmneziaWG and hooks can only be changed by an admin.
client.ownerOverLimit: This user already has {count} clients (limit {max}). Admins can still create clients for them.

toast.unknown: Unknown error. See console for more details

general.metricsPasswordDesc: Bearer Password for the metrics endpoint (password or argon2 hash)
general.jsonDesc: Route for metrics in JSON format
general.liveWireGuardEnabledDesc: Allow LiveWireGuard clients to provision their config via OIDC (GET /api/livewireguard/config)
general.liveWireGuardAudienceDesc: Expected audience (OIDC client id) of the LiveWireGuard app's tokens
general.liveWireGuardEndpointDesc: Config URL handed to the LiveWireGuard app (also encoded in the setup QR code). Empty = derived from the current host. The server path is always /api/livewireguard/config, a custom URL must reach it (e.g. via a reverse proxy). Same setting as Endpoint URL in Admin Panel → OIDC.
general.liveWireGuardStatusDesc: Saved state of the LiveWireGuard endpoint
general.unsaved: Unsaved changes, click Save to apply
general.maxClientsPerUserDesc: How many clients a user can create themselves (home page QR code, new LiveWireGuard devices). Every client of the user counts, including disabled ones. Admins are not limited, neither are clients an admin creates for a user. Lowering the value keeps existing clients.
general.maxClientsPerUserUnlimited: Unlimited: users can create any number of clients.

config.hostDesc: Public hostname clients will connect to (invalidates config)
config.portDesc: Public UDP port clients will connect to (invalidates config, you probably want to change Interface Port too)
config.allowedIpsDesc: Allowed IPs clients will use (global config)
config.dnsDesc: DNS server clients will use (global config)
config.mtuDesc: MTU clients will use (only for new clients)
config.persistentKeepaliveDesc: Interval in seconds to send keepalives to the server. 0 = disabled (only for new clients)
config.suggestDesc: Choose a IP-Address or Hostname for the Host field

interface.deviceDesc: Ethernet device the wireguard traffic should be forwarded through
interface.routingTableDesc: Routing table for WireGuard routes. Set to auto, off, or a table number.
interface.portDesc: UDP Port WireGuard will listen on (you probably want to change Config Port too)
interface.restartWarn: Are you sure to restart the interface? This will disconnect all clients.
interface.firewallEnabledDesc: Restrict client traffic to specific destination IPs using iptables. When enabled, each client can be configured with allowed destinations.
interface.clientFilterEnabledDesc: Only accept handshakes from own LiveWireGuard clients. Generic WireGuard clients (e.g. the official app) cannot connect while enabled. Existing sessions are unaffected until their next rekey.

admin.introText:
Welcome to the admin panel.

Here you can manage the general settings, the configuration, the interface settings and the hooks.

Start by choosing one of the sections in the sidebar.

oidc.panelDesc: Overrides the OAUTH_OIDC_* environment variables. Empty fields use the environment.
oidc.enabledDesc: Enable OIDC login. Not set = use the environment (OAUTH_PROVIDERS contains oidc: {env})
oidc.clientSecretDesc: Client secret of the panel (OAUTH_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET). Never displayed. Leave empty to keep it.
oidc.statusNotConfigured: Not configured (enabled, server, client id and secret are required)
oidc.panelRedirectDesc: Register this redirect URI for the panel client in your identity provider
oidc.appDesc: Values encoded in the setup QR code scanned by the LiveWireGuard app
oidc.appClientIdDesc: Client ID the app uses. Empty = use the panel client (and its secret)
oidc.appClientSecretDesc: Only for confidential app clients. It is put into the QR code. Never displayed.
oidc.appRedirectUriDesc: Redirect URI of the app, must be registered in your identity provider
oidc.endpointUrlDesc: LiveWireGuard config endpoint. Empty = derived from the current host. Same setting as Admin Panel → General → LiveWireGuard → Endpoint URL
oidc.previewDesc: Payload encoded in the QR code. It contains the client secret: only show it to trusted users.
oidc.roleMappingDesc: Give OIDC users the admin role based on the groups sent by your identity provider
oidc.adminGroupsDesc: Members of any of these groups are admins (OAUTH_OIDC_ADMIN_GROUPS). Case sensitive, a leading / is ignored. Entra ID sends group object ids.
oidc.adminGroupsNone: Not set. Role mapping is disabled, OIDC users keep their role and new users are users
oidc.groupsClaimDesc: Claim containing the groups (OAUTH_OIDC_GROUPS_CLAIM). Dotted paths like realm_access.roles are supported
oidc.panelScopesDesc: Scopes requested by the panel login (OAUTH_OIDC_SCOPES). Some providers (e.g. Okta) need an extra groups scope. Must contain openid
oidc.rule1: New OIDC users are admins if they are member of an admin group, otherwise users
oidc.rule2: Users following the OIDC groups are recalculated on every OIDC login (promoted or demoted)
oidc.rule3: Users whose role was set manually are not changed
oidc.rule4: If the groups claim is missing, the role is not changed
oidc.rule5: There is always at least one enabled admin
oidc.selfGroups: Groups of your last OIDC login
oidc.selfNoGroups: No groups received on your last OIDC login. Check the groups claim and scopes.
oidc.selfNotMatched: You are not in an admin group. Your role is kept because it was set manually or you are the last admin.
oidc.resyncDesc: Apply the saved admin groups to all users following the OIDC groups, using the groups of their last login

users.desc: Users of this panel. Admins can manage all users, clients and settings; users can only see and manage their own clients.
users.promoteDesc: {name} will be able to manage all users, clients and settings.
users.demoteDesc: {name} will only be able to see and manage their own clients. This takes effect immediately.
users.followOidcDesc: The role of {name} will be calculated from the OIDC groups on every OIDC login.
users.followOidcAdmin: Based on the last login ({groups}) {name} will be an admin.
users.followOidcClient: Based on the last login {name} is not in an admin group and will be a user.
users.followOidcUnknown: No groups known yet: the role is kept until the next OIDC login.
users.disableDesc: {name} will not be able to log in and their VPN clients will stop working. You can enable the user again at any time.
users.enableDesc: {name} will be able to log in again and their VPN clients will work again.
users.createHint: The username is used to sign in. The password must be at least 12 characters. Regular users can only manage their own clients.
users.nameDesc: Display name, defaults to the username
users.deleteDesc: Are you sure you want to delete {name}? This action cannot be undone.
users.deleteNote: The {count} clients of this user will be deleted as well.
users.manualNote: The role will be set manually and no longer follow the OIDC groups. You can switch back at any time.
users.selfHint: You cannot change your own account
users.lastAdminHint: At least one enabled admin is required
users.notOidcHint: Only for users linked with OIDC
users.groups: Groups of the last OIDC login
users.legacyAdmins: {count} admin(s) were registered via OIDC and follow the OIDC groups, but no admin groups are configured, so they stay admins. Configure admin groups or change their role.
users.clientLimitReached: Client limit reached: the user can not create more clients

client.name: Name

user.role: Role must be ADMIN or CLIENT

general.liveWireGuardEndpointUrl: LiveWireGuard endpoint URL must be a valid http(s) URL

zod.body: Body must be a valid object

awg.jCDescription: Number of junk packets to send (1-128, recommended: 4-12)
awg.jMinDescription: Minimum size of junk packets (0-1279*, recommended: 8, must be < Jmax)
awg.jMaxDescription: Maximum size of junk packets (1-1280*, recommended: 80, must be > Jmin)
awg.s1Description: Init packet junk size (0-1132[1280* - 148 = 1132], recommended: 15-150, S1+56 ≠ S2)
awg.h1Description: Init packet header value or range (X or X-Y, where X<Y. Min 5, max 2147483647. Value or range must not overlap with other headers)
awg.h2Description: Response packet header value or range (X or X-Y, where X<Y. Min 5, max 2147483647. Value or range must not overlap with other headers)
awg.h3Description: Cookie reply packet header value or range (X or X-Y, where X<Y. Min 5, max 2147483647. Value or range must not overlap with other headers)
awg.h4Description: Transport packet header value or range (X or X-Y, where X<Y. Min 5, max 2147483647. Value or range must not overlap with other headers)
awg.i1Description: Protocol mimic packet in hex format: <b 0x...>
awg.i2Description: Protocol mimic packet in hex format: <b 0x...>
awg.i3Description: Protocol mimic packet in hex format: <b 0x...>
awg.i4Description: Protocol mimic packet in hex format: <b 0x...>
awg.i5Description: Protocol mimic packet in hex format: <b 0x...>
awg.rangeNote: The following parameters accept a single number or an inclusive range (0-65535), for example 30 or 30-90
awg.headerProtectionKeyDescription: 32 byte base64 key used to encrypt packet headers. Must match on both sides, so it is copied to every client. Requires S1-S4 to be at least 12
awg.contentPaddingAdditionDescription: Random amount of bytes appended to transport packets before encryption
awg.rekeyAfterTimeDescription: Seconds before a session is renegotiated (WireGuard default: 120)
awg.keepaliveTimeoutDescription: Idle seconds before a keepalive is sent (WireGuard default: 10)
awg.maxHandshakeAttemptsDescription: Handshake attempts before giving up (WireGuard default: 18)
awg.randomTrailersDescription: Append a random amount of bytes to handshake packets. Must match on both sides, so it is copied to every client
awg.disableCookiesDescription: Do not answer handshakes with cookie messages when under load. Only affects this side of the tunnel

connect.title: Connect
connect.setupDesc: Scan this code inside the LiveWireGuard app, or use the buttons below, to set up OIDC login and the server endpoint.
connect.endpointDisabled: The LiveWireGuard endpoint is disabled. The app won't be able to fetch its config.
connect.noClient: You don't have a client yet
connect.regenerateDesc: A new client with a new key pair will be created and shown here. Your existing clients are kept and can be deleted in the list below.
connect.endpointEnable: Enable it in Admin Panel → General
connect.endpointAskAdmin: Please ask an admin to enable it.
connect.limitReached: You reached the maximum of {max} clients. Delete a client you no longer use in the list below to create a new one.
